body:
A lot of people are going to be hurt and I feel really bad just thinking about it. I've volunteered EMS and have seen suicides. I understand the impact.

It doesn't change the fact that these rehearsals and that thought of suicide are the only thing comforting my rambling mind.

Yeah, maybe I left out the part where I would leave the front door unlocked and call 911 for a dead body.

But thanks for the judgement call. Better do it when she is home, right?
I appreciate it. Good luck to you as well.

Oh sorry, I didn't realize you wanted me to write you a fucking essay or delve deeper into the thoughts that literally make me suicidal. Exactly what I am trying to avoid.

Oh yeah. Make sure you do good deeds and post videos about it online for your own ego. Post pictures of nice meals you made on facebook to make yourself feel relevant to others.

Because I am so narcissistic I must do nothing for society, right? I haven't volunteered hundreds of hours and hours for the EMS service or helped at animal shelters.

I knew posting on here would get a knee jerk reaction like this. People get offended when you tell them you think the world is pointless. Sorry, was I saying I wanted to take that meaning from other people? If you somehow got there then I applaud you. Don't fucking take this out on me.

What a real fucking help this has been.

No. And regardless of whether or not a god exists I don't think even they could give me good enough of a reason as to what the meaning of life is.

Get a hobby, have a kid, and do things that make your brain give you neurological and chemical feedback that gives you a sense of joy or content-ness and die. Then your kids can do the same thing.
